newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia bonds outshine the bloc post-data.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia bonds outshine the bloc post-data.

text.p: Australian bonds outshone their dollar bloc partners after the latest local data on retail trade showed the sector still soft.

Domestic bonds had got off on a weak footing following a renewed slide in U.S. Treasuries on Monday, but a mere 0.7 percent rise in November retail trade was sufficient to prompt yields to ease back, notably at the short-end, and differentials to tighten against the U.S..
Rumours that a U.S. investment house had recommended a switch to Australian debt from Canada spurred on the trend.
However, turnover remained relatively light despite the local firm tone with the market still on its guard ahead of key data from the U.S. later this week on inflation and the labour market.
